atr: Wilder ATR14: seed with arithmetic mean of first 14 true ranges, then ATR_t=(13*ATR_{t-1}+TR_t)/14
compression_percentile: sort exactly the previous 90 valid ATR14/close observations and use zero-based index floor(0.20*(N-1)); current signal bar is excluded
breakout_reference: highest high / lowest low of exactly the previous 20 completed 4h bars; current signal bar excluded
expansion_reference: signal candle true range divided by signal candle ATR14
